title: Zesty Tangy Argentinian Pecan Empanadas
description: Tangy and sweet empanadas filled with pecans and a soffritto base, perfect for a brunch mood, these empanadas are sugar free friendly and feature a glassy jelly like filling.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onions, garlic, and bell peppers until softened.
Add the chopped pecans to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the pecan mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Top the pecan mixture with a spoonful of quince jelly.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
